title: Decision Record
description: A log entry that captures an automated decision, its owner, clocks, and evidence links. Version 2.x adds the delegation fields that answer whether the decision still deserves to stand: the grant it was made under (grant_ref), the policies and evidence that justified it (policy_refs, evidence_basis), the conditions under which it remains valid (validity_conditions), the observations that must reopen it (reconsider_when), and the parties with standing to challenge it (parties_with_standing).

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to; 1.x records omit the delegation fields, 2.x records may carry them.

record_id.title: Record identifier
record_id.description: Stable identifier for the decision record.

receipt_id.title: Receipt identifier
receipt_id.description: Identifier of the receipt issued to the subject for this decision.

on_call.title: On call
on_call.description: Whether the owner is currently on call.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The accountable person or role for the decision.

type.title: Subject type
type.description: What kind of subject this is.

region.title: Region
region.description: Jurisdiction or region the subject belongs to.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The person, account, or entity the decision is about.

class.title: Class
class.description: Action class, such as READ, WRITE, or TRANSFER.

reversible.title: Reversible
reversible.description: Whether the action can be undone.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tools used to carry out the action.

action.title: Action
action.description: The consequential action the decision takes.

decision_type.title: Decision type
decision_type.description: The type or class of decision made.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Identifiers of the inputs the decision consumed.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Model or system confidence in the decision, from 0 to 1.

ack.title: Acknowledgement clock
ack.description: Hours to acknowledge a contested decision.

clocks.title: Clocks
clocks.description: Acknowledgement, review, remedy, and appeal clocks in hours.

href.title: Link
href.description: Where the evidence can be retrieved.

evidence_refs.title: Evidence references
evidence_refs.description: Links to the evidence behind the decision.

href.title: Link
href.description: Where to lodge or track the appeal.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.description: Where and how the decision can be appealed.

grant_ref.title: Grant reference
grant_ref.description: Identifier of the authority grant under which the decision was made. A decision made outside an allowed grant is not a delegated decision; it is drift.

policy_refs.title: Policy references
policy_refs.description: Identifiers of the policy records whose propositions the decision relied on.

evidence_basis.title: Evidence basis
evidence_basis.description: The propositions that justified the decision at the time, with their freshness, so a reviewer can tell whether the evidentiary state has since changed.

items.title: Evidence reference
items.description: A pointer to a policy record or evidence item with its summary and freshness.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Identifier or URL of the policy record or evidence item.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Plain-language summary of what the evidence establishes.

as_of.title: As of
as_of.description: When the evidence was last confirmed.

validity_conditions.title: Validity conditions
validity_conditions.description: Conditions that must keep holding for the decision to deserve to stand.

reconsider_when.title: Reconsider when
reconsider_when.description: Observations that must reopen the decision, each paired with the action they force. An observation that cannot change state is theater.

items.title: Reconsideration rule
items.description: One condition and the action it forces.

action.title: Action
action.description: What happens when the condition holds, matching reconsideration outcomes or a review state.

parties_with_standing.title: Parties with standing
parties_with_standing.description: Who may challenge this decision, drawn from the standing register for its decision class.

standing_register_ref.title: Standing register reference
standing_register_ref.description: Identifier of the standing register that governs challenges to this decision.
